description: List custom field values. Filter by entity_id to get all custom fields for a specific record, or by field_definition_id.

entity_id.description: Filter by entity ID (e.g. asset ID, work order ID)

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.
